question: The marks obtained by 15 students out of a maximum of 26 in a test are given as 14, 12, 17, 16, 19, 13, 14, 15, 11, 23, 16, 22, 21, 18 and 25. Find the product of the possible modes of this set of data.
solution:
**Given:**

Data = 14, 12, 17, 16, 19, 13, 14, 15, 11, 23, 16, 22, 21, 18, 25

**Formula Used:**

Mode = Value(s) with highest frequency

**Calculation:**

⇒ 11 → 1 time

⇒ 12 → 1 time

⇒ 13 → 1 time

⇒ 14 → 2 times

⇒ 15 → 1 time

⇒ 16 → 2 times

⇒ 17 → 1 time

⇒ 18 → 1 time

⇒ 19 → 1 time

⇒ 21 → 1 time

⇒ 22 → 1 time

⇒ 23 → 1 time

⇒ 25 → 1 time

⇒ Modes = 14 and 16

⇒ Product = 14 × 16

⇒ = 224

∴ The correct answer is 224.
